findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "?src=mcp_official_registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: crypto.market-analyzer, ops.link-integrity, oracle.cross-chain-prices, oracle.historical-analysis, oracle.price-feed, research.topic-deep-researcher · Private data: data.business-registry, finops.token-spend-audit, oracle.cross-chain-prices, procurement.trust-layer, reputation.lookup, research.topic-deep-researcher, security.audit-attestation, security.concordium-card-verify, translation.zh-en · Public sink: arbitration.dispute-settlement, ops.link-integrity · Destructive: crypto.market-analyzer, oracle.comprehensive-report, research.topic-deep-researcher, security.audit-attestation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: crypto.market-analyzer, ops.link-integrity, oracle.cross-chain-prices, oracle.historical-analysis, oracle.price-feed, research.topic-deep-researcher · Private data: data.business-registry, finops.token-spend-audit, oracle.cross-chain-prices, procurement.trust-layer, reputation.lookup, research.topic-deep-researcher, security.audit-attestation, security.concordium-card-verify, translation.zh-en · Public sink: arbitration.dispute-settlement, ops.link-integrity · Destructive: crypto.market-analyzer, oracle.comprehensive-report, research.topic-deep-researcher, security.audit-attestation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
